scenes.headline: How a 4B image model stays fast
scenes.sub: Mage-Flow: a cheap tokenizer, a backbone that never crops, a 4-step sampler.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Breeze! Open image models keep getting bigger. Microsoft's Mage-Flow goes the other way: four billion parameters, for generation and editing. Here's how it keeps up.

scenes.label: The bet
scenes.text: Don't grow one layer; co-design three. A far cheaper tokenizer, a backbone that packs any aspect ratio, and fused training kernels.
scenes.say: The bet: don't grow one layer, co-design three. A much cheaper tokenizer, a backbone that takes any aspect ratio, and fused kernels that train it faster.

scenes.title: From prompt to pixels, no crops

steps.say: Qwen3-VL reads the prompt. Mage-VAE, a tokenizer distilled from FLUX.2's, turns the image into compact latents in a single step.
It matches FLUX.2's fidelity with about twelve times fewer operations to encode and twenty-two times fewer to decode, and every later stage inherits that saving.
The key move: each image becomes a token sequence of its own length, packed with the text into one batch. No resolution buckets, no center crops.
A four billion parameter diffusion transformer reads the pack, and per-sample rotary embeddings keep each image's own layout, out to a four to one panorama.

items.say: The base model is trained with rectified flow matching.
Reinforcement learning with Diffusion-NFT improves prompt following, text rendering and editing.
Then distillation turns a thirty-step sampler into four steps: a 1024-pixel image drops from four point three seven seconds to zero point five nine.

scenes.label: peak GPU memory for generation and editing, against 58.8 GB for Qwen-Image
scenes.say: And it fits: about eighteen to twenty gigabytes of GPU memory, against fifty-eight point eight for Qwen-Image. One desktop-class card.

scenes.text: Image-model efficiency is a co-design problem, not a scale problem: every layer pulls its weight.
scenes.say: So efficiency is a co-design problem, not a scale problem. Every layer pulls its weight, and a 4B model stands next to giants.

recap: Mage-VAE: a tokenizer an order of magnitude cheaper
Any aspect ratio, packed into one batch
scenes.say: To recap: a cheap tokenizer, packing instead of cropping, and a four-step sampler.
